about: Shared exercise capabilities for Studio and Blender. holds/support describe required equipment; built/supportBuilt enable the implemented contact paths; referenceMotion uses edited reference poses instead of a generic clip. automatic enables unattended attempts only after validation. Reference preflight, physical contact, deformation and form checks can still block or reject a result. depth enables the squat depth comparison. Unsupported named exercises and unknown equipment keep their explicit refusals.

Standing Barbell Overhead Press (Shoulde.automationBlocker: The reference pose has not passed head/bar clearance and safe arm-reach checks on this mascot.

Pull-Up.automationBlocker: Keeping the fixed pull-up bar clear of the head exceeds the current safe two-hand reach. This profile needs further body and arm calibration.

Lat Pulldown (seated, to the front).automationBlocker: The current reference/model combination does not reach the required overhead start. Support and grip contact pass, but the pulldown range is incomplete.

Dumbbell Shoulder Press (seated overhead.automationBlocker: The current mascot has not passed the overhead-completion and weight/head-clearance checks. Grip contact alone does not make this a valid overhead press.

Front Plank (forearm plank).automationBlocker: The static hold is implemented, but this mascot has not passed forearm and toe support checks. Kneeling setup pictures are never animated as plank repetitions.

Tricep Pushdown (cable, bar or rope atta.automationBlocker: The reference bar path has not passed body-clearance and bounded arm-reach checks on this mascot.

refusals.steps: No motion for this exercise: its feet step, which the picture path can't animate yet. Add {clip} to 3d-character/mixamo (its README says how).
refusals.support: No motion for this exercise: it needs a {support} the picture path doesn't build yet.

unheld: No {holds} on this path yet; the hands hold nothing
